## Theorem: minimal shared-label alphabet

For a finite distinguishable population S, budget k>=1, let A_d(R) be the downward-closed family of target subsets identifiable by a depth<=d tree on full competing residual R. A_d(empty)={empty}. Q contains each distinct oriented informative positive mask, and optionally the two virtual padding masks empty and S. For q in Q define L_q=A_{k-1}(q), R_q=A_{k-1}(S\q). Write X*Y={x union y:x in X,y in Y}. Then A_k(S)=union_q L_q*R_q (for |S|<=1 include padding). The two virtual roots do not change the true family since any shorter tree is permitted. For a label partition P of Q, the coarse shared-label family is
H(P)=union_{C in P} union_{q,r in C} L_q*R_r.
This is exactly disjoint target-group packing within a class: if x,y overlap, delete their intersection from one group by downward closure, leaving their union unchanged. Every actual root remains represented, so A_k subset H(P); singleton classes give equality. The one-class case with virtual padding equals GAN's h=k-1 independent two-slot packing when k>=2.

Let G be the undirected simple graph on Q, with edge {q,r} iff L_q*R_r or L_r*R_q is not contained in A_k. A label partition is exact for the entire target family iff each class is independent in G. Proof: any edge inside a class supplies an attainable coarse union outside A_k; conversely if all classes independent, all cross products in the definition lie in A_k, including diagonals. Therefore minimum label alphabet size equals the chromatic number chi(G). The claim is scoped to shared equality labels with arbitrary cross products inside a class, not all possible encoding schemes. For fixed nonnegative weights, maximum score is preserved by family equality. Conversely if a new target T is added, indicator weights on T distinguish the two families. Maximal recovered groups suffice to build edges: a downward-closed allowed family contains every cross union iff it contains the unions of all maximal pairs. This is a finite observer-specific exact quotient of root-compatibility relations, not a state equivalence or a license to physically combine incompatible subtrees. An attainable target in the quotient may recover its actual witness by selecting a genuine root whose diagonal family contains it.

More generally let D be a downward-closed admissible family containing A_k, e.g. all sets of size<=b, all sets not containing a certified forbidden target, or their intersection. Replace A_k by D in edge tests. Then H(P) subset D iff P is a proper coloring of that graph. A partition and verified child families may certify such a bound without constructing A_k in advance; for the all-target graph in this experiment the true family was already available, so this is an exact structural classification, not a claimed faster solver. A shared label is an observer resource: different objectives can require different minimal alphabets.
